acceptance_criterion: In pre‑production field trials within approved jurisdictions, the system can sustain hands‑free operation on divided highways at speeds up to 70 mph for 100+ miles with no driver interventions in ≥95% of trips and successfully complete handovers when jurisdictional limits are reached.
